summary.en: The whole system as one line: a person, the product's steps, a person again; boxes on a 3 px rule with arrows, the person's nodes in the accent, a bracket over the steps, a loop back underneath, then one statement and a list.
summary.zh: 整个系统画成一条线：人、产品的几个步骤、再回到人；方框排在 3 px 的线上，有箭头相连，人的节点是强调色，步骤上方有括号，下方画一条回环，最后一句陈述和一行清单。

fits: The page that sums up how it works: who starts it, what runs, who signs, what happens on failure.
notFor: More than six nodes; branching flows (it is one line); systems with no person in them.

intent.en: Put the person at both ends of the system in one glance: the accent bookends the line, so the claim "you start it, you sign it" is a picture.
intent.zh: 一眼看到人在系统两端：强调色把这条线首尾夹住，“你发起、你签字”就成了一幅图。

content.en: Title, 3–6 nodes (name ≤ 11 chars, note ≤ 13; which are the person), a bracket label, a loop label, one statement and a list line.
content.zh: 标题、3–6 个节点（名称 ≤ 4 字、注释 ≤ 5 字，标明哪些是人）、括号标签、回环标签、一句陈述和一行清单。

fits.zh: 总结“怎么运作”的一页：谁发起、跑什么、谁签字、失败了怎样。

notFor.zh: 超过六个节点；有分支的流程（它是一条线）；没有人参与的系统。

pairs.note: its pick carries into the first node (block-carry)
how to start after the how-it-works

en: With five or six nodes each box is two columns wide: names longer than 8 Latin or 3 Chinese characters overflow.
Without a `from` rect, `enterBy: reblock` falls back to the pop-in.
zh: 五六个节点时每格只有两栏宽：拉丁名超过 8 个字符、中文超过 3 个字会溢出。
没给 from 矩形时，enterBy: reblock 退回普通弹入。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
